rows.formation_text: Rahu in 1st, Ketu in 7th, all planets within the arc.
rows.effects_text: Self vs partnership tension; identity and marriage karma.
Anger, accidents, impulsive conflict, blood/inflammation issues.

rows.formation_text: The Badhaka lord (11th for movable lagnas, 9th for fixed, 7th for dual) afflicts the lagna or its lord.
rows.effects_text: Hidden obstacles, unexplained chronic difficulties, enemies from unexpected quarters; effects are obstructive rather than directly harmful.

severity_grades.mild: badhaka lord weak or in friendly sign
severity_grades.severe: badhaka lord strong in kendra/dusthana aspecting lagna

formation_rule_jsonb.requires: afflicted Moon (with malefics, no benefic aspect) in early life indications

rows.formation_text: Malefic affliction to the Moon/lagna indicating affliction in infancy (per BPHS Arishta-adhyaya).
rows.effects_text: Classical infant-affliction yoga; read with longevity factors.

formation_rule_jsonb.requires: birth at rashi/bhava sandhi (sign or house junction) with malefic influence on lagna/Moon

rows.formation_text: Birth at a sign or house junction (sandhi) with the lagna/Moon under malefic influence (BPHS Ch.9).
rows.effects_text: Junction-birth arishta; vulnerability in early life.

formation_rule_jsonb.requires: waning Moon in 6/8/12 conjunct/aspected by malefics without benefic relief

rows.formation_text: A weak (waning) Moon in the 6th, 8th or 12th, afflicted by malefics and without benefic aspect (a BPHS Ch.9 arishta).
rows.effects_text: Classical infant-affliction configuration; weigh with longevity factors.

formation_rule_jsonb.requires: lagna or Moon hemmed by malefics in the 2nd and 12th from it (papa-kartari) without benefic aspect

rows.formation_text: The lagna or the Moon is hemmed between malefics (papa-kartari) with no benefic relief (BPHS Ch.9).
rows.effects_text: Hemming arishta; squeezes the vitality of the hemmed point.

bhanga: benefic aspect on the hemmed point

rows.formation_text: Moon conjunct Rahu — Chandal yoga; the intellect and emotions corrupted.
rows.effects_text: Mental distortions, deceptive tendencies, unconventional behaviour; can also give extraordinary perceptive ability if strong.

rows.formation_text: Moon conjunct Rahu or Ketu — natal lunar eclipse combination.
rows.effects_text: Mental affliction, emotional instability, distorted perceptions; mother-related karma; Rahu conjunct Moon is also called Chandal combination.

severity_grades.severe: close conjunction in 4th/12th with weak Moon

formation_rule_jsonb.requires: planet within combustion orb of Sun (varies by planet)

rows.formation_text: A planet within its classical combustion orb of the Sun — Maudhya (burnt) state.
rows.effects_text: Planet's significations burnt out or suppressed; the ego (Sun) overwhelms the planet's natural expression. House lordships of the combust planet are weakened.

bhanga: planet retrograde (especially Mercury/Venus — reduces combustion effect)
planet in own or exaltation sign despite combustion
